scope: Independent postprocessing of first two exported source coefficient vectors, not a physical operator/SVD or repository test-suite replay.
local_input_method: Explicit transcription of GitHub.fetch_file lines 1455-1603, first two RESOLVED_PHYSICAL source_coefficient_vectors. Not a claim of local full-file rehash. The companion script additionally checks saved right vectors when run on the full repository export.
source_basis: Repository L224 four log-radius cubic B-splines, six nonconstant Fourier factors, three selected degree-one temporal hats.
model_norm: r dr dphi dt, not proper-volume or a prior
integration_note: Gauss radial plus exact piecewise-quadratic temporal integration; slight normalization difference from archived midpoint quadrature is divided out in each energy fraction.
interpretation: Normalized-coordinate shares are not source energy in original hats or physical time windows. The separate total-trace epoch diagnostic also groups transformed coordinates and requires relabeling, not a change to the accepted total traces or spectra.
